name: Adzviser Omnisend
description:
Connect your Omnisend data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about emails sent, open rate, and click rate. Compare campaigns, dig into how your automations are performing, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking last week's sends or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Omnisend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Omnisend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://omnisend.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Omnisend MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Omnisend provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_omnisend, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Omnisend?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Omnisend in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Omnisend MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Omnisend requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Omnisend is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
